_meta.note: English is the source language. Proper names (CANTRE, NRWN, OGL-Canada) are not translated.

messages.app.title: CANTRE
messages.app.tagline: Calculated railway milepost from your GPS, on this device
messages.app.footer: Research software. Not for safety, operations or track access.
messages.app.noDataYet: No rail data is loaded yet.
messages.boundary.title: Something went wrong
messages.boundary.body: The app stopped. Your location was not sent anywhere. Error code:
messages.lock.clearedOnReload: Lock cleared on reload. Choose the route again if you need it.
messages.lock.clearedByUpdate: Lock cleared because the data was updated. Choose the route again if you need it.
messages.status.STALE: Historical: the last GPS fix is old
messages.status.MATCHED_SUBDIVISION: On this subdivision, track not identified
messages.status.LOCK_CONFLICT: Your chosen route does not fit this fix
messages.reason.PERMISSION_DENIED: Location permission was denied. Allow location for this site in the browser settings.
messages.reason.LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: The device could not provide a location.
messages.reason.NO_FIX_YET: No GPS fix has arrived yet.
messages.reason.FIX_STALE: The last fix is older than 15 seconds, so this is the last known result, not the current one.
messages.reason.FIX_FROM_FUTURE: The fix is timestamped in the future, so it cannot be trusted as current.
messages.reason.FIX_IGNORED_OUT_OF_ORDER: A fix that arrived out of order was ignored.
messages.reason.FIX_IGNORED_INVALID: A fix with invalid values was ignored.
messages.reason.OUTSIDE_LOADED_TILES: The fix is outside the area covered by the loaded data.
messages.reason.PARTIAL_COVERAGE: Part of the search area is outside the loaded data, so a nearer track may be missing.
messages.reason.NO_CANDIDATE_IN_RADIUS: No mapped track lies within the GPS accuracy of the fix.
messages.reason.DIAMOND_NEARBY: A crossing of two tracks is nearby, so the track cannot be told apart safely.
messages.reason.MULTIPLE_ROUTES: Tracks of different routes are close together and the fix cannot tell them apart.
messages.reason.MULTIPLE_TRACKS: Several tracks of the same route are close together and the fix cannot tell them apart.
messages.reason.HEADING_USED: The direction of travel helped choose between nearby tracks.
messages.reason.HEADING_INCONSISTENT: The direction of travel does not match the nearby tracks.
messages.reason.CONTINUITY: The track was kept from the previous fixes.
messages.reason.CONTINUITY_HOLD: The previous track is kept for now, but recent fixes disagree with it.
messages.reason.LOCKED_BY_USER: The route is the one you chose.
messages.reason.LOCK_NOT_SUPPORTED: The chosen route cannot be used for a milepost here.
messages.reason.DISCONTINUITY_GAP: The milepost numbering has a gap here, so no value is calculated across it.
messages.reason.CHAIN_UNCALIBRATED: This track has no reliable milepost reference, so no milepost is shown.
messages.reason.TRACK_MP_DISAGREE: Nearby tracks give different mileposts, so none is shown.
messages.reason.TRACK_UNCALIBRATED: This track has no milepost reference.
messages.reason.UNCHAINED_TRACK: This track is not part of a connected route, so no milepost is shown.
messages.app.noDataBody: Rail data has to be installed before a position can be shown. The download screen is not part of this build yet.
messages.card.mpMiles: Mileposts are numbered in miles and are not converted. Distances here are in kilometres.
messages.card.noSingleMp: No single milepost: the parallel tracks do not give one value.
messages.tier.posted: Reference points posted by the railway.
messages.tier.tc: Reference points from the Transport Canada inventory.
messages.tier.unverified: Unverified reference points: this milepost comes from unchecked values, so treat it with extra care.
messages.route.heading: Choose your route
messages.route.help: More than one route fits this fix. Pick the one you are on. Your choice does not make the GPS more precise.
messages.route.conflictHelp: Your chosen route does not fit this fix. Pick another route, or unlock.
messages.route.notLockable: Not part of a connected route, so it cannot be chosen.
messages.asset.heading: Nearby assets
messages.asset.none: No mapped assets close by along this track.
messages.asset.listNote: Distances are along the track, from the dataset, not surveyed.
messages.asset.side.unknownForward: on one side along the track
messages.asset.side.unknownBack: on the other side along the track
messages.asset.noSource: No source attributes are available for this asset.
messages.find.heading: Find a location
messages.find.intro: Choose a subdivision and type a milepost to see where it lies. This works without GPS and without the map. The same name can belong to different subdivisions, so each entry shows its operator and, for repeated names, its milepost range and a rough place.
messages.find.invalidMp: Enter the milepost as a number, for example 12.5.
messages.find.noInterval: No calibrated range in this subdivision includes that milepost, so no position is given. Positions are never guessed outside the known ranges.
messages.find.pinNote: Calculated from the dataset's reference points, not surveyed, and not a GPS position.
messages.map.heading: Map
messages.map.loadFailed: The map could not be loaded. Everything else still works.
messages.map.label: Map of the mapped tracks and assets. The status card and the find form give the same information as text.
messages.map.note: Tracks and assets are drawn from the dataset on this device, not surveyed. Tap the map to see the calculated milepost at that spot.
messages.map.attribution.ogl: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada
messages.map.basemap.off: The basemap is off. Tracks and assets are drawn on a plain background and no map tiles are fetched.
messages.map.basemap.on: The basemap is on. Map tiles are fetched for the area shown.
messages.map.basemap.notice: Turning on the basemap fetches map tiles from OpenFreeMap for the area shown on the map. That request tells OpenFreeMap which area you are looking at. Your GPS position is not sent, and the tracks and assets stay on this device.
messages.map.tap.label: From map position, no GPS
messages.map.tap.none: No mapped track is within reach of that spot.
messages.map.basemapFailed: The basemap could not be loaded, so the plain background is shown. Tracks and assets are still drawn.
messages.map.keyboardAlternative: Tapping the map gives the milepost at a spot. The keyboard alternative is Find a location, above.
messages.error.MANIFEST_INVALID: The data list from the server is not valid. Try again later.
messages.error.FETCH_FAILED: The data could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.
messages.error.HASH_MISMATCH: The downloaded data did not pass its integrity check and was not used.
messages.error.NOT_INSTALLED: No rail data is installed on this device yet.
